hints.title: Minimum Dollar Guarantee
hints.text: Every child must receive at least 1 dollar, so if money is strictly less than children, no valid distribution exists.

hints.title: Candidate Eight Count
hints.text: After reserving 1 dollar per child, each child needing 8 dollars requires an additional 7 dollars.

hints.title: Forbidden Four Adjustment
hints.text: If exactly one child remains with 3 additional dollars (giving 4 dollars total), you must sacrifice one 8-dollar allocation to prevent 4 dollars.

hints.title: Greedy Allocation with Four Avoidance Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct mathematical integer division and boundary case tests.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of partitioning integers takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handles edge cases cleanly including 4-dollar prohibition and surplus money.
